scenes.context: 框眼睛、挡嘴巴两个位置。
sentences: 有框架的就去框，能遮挡的就去挡。
Frame what has a frame, cover what can be covered.
至于框哪儿、挡哪儿，记住两个位置就好——眼睛，还有嘴巴。
Where to frame or cover—remember two spots: eyes and mouth.
